subject: spanish
title: Adjective Agreement
meta_desc: KS3 Spanish: adjective agreement, gender, number.
final_note: Adjectives in Spanish change with the noun.

walkthroughs.body_html: Adjectives ending in -o change with the noun: rojo (m), roja (f), rojos (m pl), rojas (f pl). Adjectives ending in -e (like grande) don't change for gender.
Most Spanish adjectives go after the noun: 'un libro rojo' (a red book), 'una mesa pequena' (a small table).
'La silla es bonita' = 'The chair is pretty' (chair is feminine, so bonita). 'Los libros son nuevos' = 'The books are new' (plural masculine = nuevos).
